scope: Functional verification of automatic failure capture and redacted support diagnostics; this is not model token/speed retention evidence

checks: first browser failure captured before cleanup
form fields and foreign frames masked
bundle omits private payloads and images
noninteractive auth propagated to native booking validation
conversation grading checks dates, room/time coverage and write counts

live_read_only_control.request: Dedicated room-details lookup for a deliberately nonexistent diagnostic name

verification_issues_resolved: A development run rejected a source fingerprint change during a shared-host test; both full suites passed after keeping app source fixed
An existing MFA privacy test falsely matched challenge digits inside a random operation ID; the deterministic test now excludes only the opaque ID while checking all remaining public fields
limitations: No real booking, amendment, cancellation or approval was submitted
Unavailable/authentication/browserless failures may have no image
Historical read operations and images cannot be recovered after expiry or restart
Conversation scenarios use synthetic FBS records and do not replace live native-path verification
